<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-1602-40-25" status="unreviewed"><lb edRef="inst:4749" n="14a9"/> da ni bshad thabs kyi yan lag bshad pa bya'o || 
            
            'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> na re chos bshad thabs gyi yan lang bsaM pa dang | bshad par bya ba bstan chos kyi rang bzhin dang | gzhan 'jug pa'i yan lag du
            gyur pa'i dgos 'brel rnaM par gzhag pa dang | mngon par 'dod pa'i gzung don bstan pa ste bzhis
            shes par bya'o || zhes zer ro || </seg></TEI>
